player_prompt.intro:
Ni wowe Umukinnyi {player_id} muri Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma igera kwa mizunguko {num_rounds}.

Imiterere y'Umukino:
- Mbere ya kila uamuzi ufite imyanya {total_conversation_rounds} yo kuganiriza ukwishaka.
- Nyuma yaho, abakinnyi bombi batora icyo bakora kwa wakati mwe.

Matiti y'Umukino (yahinduwe kwa kila mzunguko):
- Bombi bashingira hamwe ➜ buri {cooperate_reward}
- Bombi bahagaritse ➜ buri {mutual_defect_reward}
- Umwe ahagaritse, umwe ashyingira hamwe ➜ Uwahagaritse {defect_reward}, Uwashyingira hamwe {sucker_reward}

Uko wakinnye:
- Mugihe cya kuganiriza: andika icyo ushaka.
- Mugihe cya kufanya uamuzi: ongera '[Cooperate]' cyangwa '[Defect]' (ntacyo kigira ingaruka). Ushobora kongeza ibindi byo kwandika mbere cyangwa nyuma y'ikimenyetso.

phases.conversation_finished: Ijambo ryarangiye kwa mzunguko wa {round}. Nyemerera kuyasubiza na '[Cooperate]' cyangwa '[Defect]' muri \boxed{{}}.

outcome.round_both_defect: Abo bakinnyi bombi bahise bacika intege.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Umukinnyi wa 0 yaracitse, naho uwa 1 arafatanya.
